phrase: an Ayurvedic Beauty and Hair Care Brand
verdict: Yes. Shesha Ayurveda from Kochi pitched ayurvedic beauty and hair care on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Kerala's Ayurveda tradition carries strong trust, and authentic recipes command premium prices.
angle: Kerala Ayurveda is known worldwide. Hair oils, face oils and herbal products made to traditional recipes sell to Indian and export buyers. AYUSH licensing and sourcing transparency build trust.
